sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE is_deleted = 0;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND is_deleted = 0;

SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products
WHERE is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id)
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.is_deleted = 0
  AND o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.is_deleted = 0;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND region_id IS NULL;

SELECT sku
FROM products
WHERE is_deleted = 0
  AND category = 'Hardware';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) AS gross_invoiced_amount
FROM invoices i
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
WHERE i.invoice_date >= '2026-07-01'
  AND i.invoice_date < '2026-10-01'
  AND i.status <> 'void'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.is_deleted = 0;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS net_cash_collected
FROM payments
WHERE datetime(paid_at_utc, '+330 minutes') >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00'
  AND datetime(paid_at_utc, '+330 minutes') < '2026-10-01 00:00:00';

WITH customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM customers AS c
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_deleted = 0
    AND o.is_deleted = 0
    AND o.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT customer_id, order_count
FROM customer_order_counts
WHERE order_count = (SELECT MAX(order_count) FROM customer_order_counts);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_value), 2)
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    COALESCE(
      SUM(
        oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount_pct, 0) / 100.0)
      ),
      0
    ) AS order_value
  FROM orders AS o
  LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.is_deleted = 0
    AND o.order_date >= date('2026-10-15', '-89 days')
    AND o.order_date <= '2026-10-15'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
);

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date) AS month,
       SUM(i.amount) AS total
FROM invoices AS i
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
WHERE i.status <> 'void'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.is_deleted = 0
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date) IN ('2026-06', '2026-07', '2026-08')
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

SELECT COALESCE(
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    4
  ),
  0
)
FROM invoices i
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
WHERE i.invoice_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30'
  AND i.status <> 'void'
  AND o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.is_deleted = 0;

WITH dates AS (
  SELECT '2026-06-30' AS order_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT d.order_date, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM dates d
LEFT JOIN orders o
  ON o.order_date = d.order_date
 AND o.is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY d.order_date
ORDER BY d.order_date;

SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count
FROM customers
WHERE is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

SELECT
  r.name AS region_name,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount < 0 THEN -p.amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount > 0 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END), 0),
    4
  ) AS refund_ratio
FROM regions r
LEFT JOIN customers c
  ON c.region_id = r.region_id
  AND c.is_deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN orders o
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  AND o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.is_deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN invoices i
  ON i.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN payments p
  ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
GROUP BY
  r.region_id,
  r.name;

WITH product_units AS (
  SELECT
    p.sku,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS units
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    AND o.is_deleted = 0
    AND p.is_deleted = 0
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY p.sku
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    sku,
    units,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY units DESC) AS rnk
  FROM product_units
)
SELECT sku, units
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY units DESC, sku ASC;

SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.is_deleted = 0
  AND o.is_deleted = 0
  AND o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING MAX(o.order_date) < '2026-06-17'
ORDER BY last_order_date, c.customer_id;

SELECT c.customer_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.method = 'refund' THEN -ABS(p.amount) ELSE p.amount END) AS net_amount
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN payments AS p ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
WHERE c.is_deleted = 0
  AND o.is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN p.method = 'refund' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY net_amount DESC, c.customer_id ASC;
